scenario.description: A forward operating base commander must publish the day's generator load sequence for four essential support activities and record the power-control actions required by each section.

shared_context.S1: The main generator can support only one of the four planned high-load activities at a time.
shared_context.S2: Today's power-control period runs from 0800 to 1600 and has four available two-hour blocks: 0800-1000, 1000-1200, 1200-1400, and 1400-1600.
shared_context.S3: The four activities that must be scheduled are the generator load test, clinic refrigeration transfer, communications-battery recharge, and water-point pumping.
shared_context.S4: Col. Mercer issues the binding power schedule, and the routine 0700 power-control board meeting is used for each section to report changes before the schedule is published.

PF1.text: Maj. Singh confirmed from the electrician's inspection sheet this morning that the generator load test must use the 1400-1600 block, when the calibration crew is available to verify the breaker settings; the inspection sheet has not yet been attached to the command brief.

PF2.text: Capt. Alvarez confirmed with the medical-supply custodian that the clinic refrigeration transfer must use the 0800-1000 block, when the replacement cold-storage unit and its qualified technician are both available; the clinic transfer note is still in the medical section's working folder.

PF3.text: Lt. Brooks confirmed that the communications-battery recharge must use the 1200-1400 block because the signal technician's configuration check is scheduled then and the required stabilized output will be available; the updated signal work card is not yet on the power board.

PF4.text: SFC Holloway confirmed that water-point pumping must use the 1000-1200 block because the pump crew will connect the treated-water manifold during that block; the revised pumping sequence remains in the water-point log.

acceptance_conditions: The generator load test must be scheduled for 1400-1600 and must not share a block with the clinic refrigeration transfer.
The clinic refrigeration transfer must be scheduled for 0800-1000 and must not share a block with the communications-battery recharge.
The communications-battery recharge must be scheduled for 1200-1400 and must not share a block with water-point pumping.
Water-point pumping must be scheduled for 1000-1200 and must not share a block with the generator load test.
The generator sequencing requirement must be cited in the commander's justification.

decisive_facts.why: The inspection-sheet requirement changes the generator load test to the exact 1400-1600 block and establishes that it must differ from the clinic transfer, while supplying the fact required for the cited justification.
The custodian and technician availability changes the clinic refrigeration transfer to the exact 0800-1000 block and requires it to differ from the communications recharge.
The signal technician's configuration window changes the communications-battery recharge to the exact 1200-1400 block and requires it to differ from water-point pumping.
The treated-water manifold connection changes water-point pumping to the exact 1000-1200 block and requires it to differ from the generator load test.
